title: typikon journal entry
description: Frontmatter contract for a journal entry (content/journal/<slug>.md). Stricter than the page schema: date and the entry-level extras are required so the auto-generated journal-section listing renders cleanly.

date.description: ISO 8601 date. Sort key for the journal listing.

audience.description: Intended reader context for the entry. Required so rendered deliverables carry audience assumptions explicitly.

components.description: Tag-line of conceptual components, e.g. 'ardere · presence · the question'. Rendered under the title in the journal listing and on the entry page itself.

words.description: Approximate word count, e.g. '~480' or '~480 words'.

words_source.description: Source for the rendered word-count claim, e.g. 'manual count' or the counting tool used.

author.description: Per-entry author override; falls back to config.extra.author.name.
